beats.care: If you're from Vidarbha, Marathwada, Konkan or Kolhapur side, book a seat early on the MSRTC app or website.
beats.what: MSRTC's Pune division plans 400+ buses from Pimpri-Chinchwad and 200 from Swargate, plus specials from Shivajinagar, on Nov 4–7.
beats.why: Thousands of students and workers go home for Diwali, and train seats are nearly sold out.

cards.body: 40 to Vidarbha, 35 to Marathwada and 10 to western Maharashtra, NativePlanet reports.
cards.caption: Regular buses already full

cards.body: Swargate's 200 extra buses go to Satara, Sangli, Kolhapur, Solapur and Konkan. Pimpri-Chinchwad depot is near the metro.
Khadki Cantonment was dropped as a boarding point because it was inconvenient for passengers.

opts: Train seats are nearly full for the Diwali rush
cards.q: Why is MSRTC adding so many buses?
cards.why: Diwali travel demand is huge and train reservations are almost full.

hook: Train tickets gone? *600 extra buses* leave Pune for Diwali.

learn.t: Over 400 of the special buses will leave from Pimpri-Chinchwad depot, mostly to Vidarbha, Marathwada and Khandesh.

sources.name: Punekar News
sources.title: MSRTC to Run Over 600 Special Buses From Pune For Diwali Rush

sources.name: NativePlanet
sources.title: Pune Special Buses: MSRTC has Planned to Operate More than 600 Buses from Nov 4 to 7

tldr: MSRTC will run over 600 special buses from Pune from November 4 to 7 for people heading home for Diwali.
watch: Special buses run November 4–7; online booking on the MSRTC website and app.
